response.text: {"verdict": "covered", "clause_ids": ["A4.1"], "rationale": "The claim involves medical treatment (hospitalization and treatment for a fracture of the distal radius) resulting from an accident during a tandem paragliding flight. Clause A4.1 explicitly covers medical expenses, including hospitalization, resulting from an acute illness or injury during the trip. There is no indication that the injury was pre-existing, planned, or related to excluded activities (such as extreme sports) under the Premium product, which is not applicable here. Therefore, the claim is covered under A4.1."}
